text: 1920s Paris street ambience, horse carriages on cobblestones, an old motor car passing with a honk horn, cafe chatter, a distant accordion, no modern traffic, no music
old mechanical cash register cha-ching with a bright bell, single hit, close
elegant 1920s grand hotel salon ambience, soft murmur of men talking, glasses clinking, a distant string quartet playing quietly, warm room tone
old scrapyard ambience, iron beams clanking, a distant hammer on metal, creaking crane chain, light wind, no music
a thick paper envelope full of banknotes slid across a wooden table, paper rustle and soft slide, close
1920s steam train departing a station, loud steam whistle followed by heavy chuffing that speeds up, hiss of steam
a French police whistle blown twice in a stone street at night, short echo
a man running fast in leather shoes on wet cobblestones at night, footsteps splashing, heavy breathing, moving away
1930s New York street ambience, old car horns, streetcar bell, crowd of pedestrians, distant newsboy shout, no modern sounds, no music
old printing press running in a basement, rhythmic mechanical clatter and thumps of paper sheets, close
a large newspaper being opened and pages turned quickly, crisp paper rustle, close
huge old iron structure creaking and groaning in the wind, metallic stress, flakes of rust falling, high up, slow
